title: Deliver a zero-additional-AWS-cost private TLS foundation for Vault
classification_reason: creates a private certificate authority key and TLS Secrets
extends the private artifact supply chain
forms a security boundary for Vault API and Raft traffic
expected_outcome: The private EKS cluster can obtain and renew the Vault-only vault-tls Secret without AWS Private CA or public egress: a digest-pinned cert-manager chart and images are mirrored into approved private ECR, cert-manager bootstraps an internal Vault-only CA, and a Certificate controller writes vault-tls with tls.crt, tls.key, and ca.crt. No Secret material is read, printed, committed, or manually changed.
constraints: Use only account 106760547719 and EKS cluster node-operator.
Do not create or use AWS Private CA, ACM Private CA Connector, public CA, NAT, Internet gateway, LoadBalancer, public DNS, or public listener.
The internal CA is Vault-only; it must not become a cluster-wide or organizational trust root.
Only cert-manager controllers may create or update cert-manager CA-key Secrets and vault/vault-tls. No human or agent may read, print, copy, commit, or log Secret data or private keys.
All cert-manager chart and image artifacts must be version- and digest-pinned, approved, and available through private ECR before private-cluster install.
Preserve Vault's existing internal-only service and require an explicit NetworkPolicy design before the Vault Helm deployment is unblocked.
Record only non-sensitive identities, versions, digests, resource metadata, and boolean readiness results.

authorization.user_approval: User explicitly selected the cluster-internal CA option for the portfolio environment on 2026-09-04 after being informed that it has no AWS Private CA monthly charge and that the CA private key is held in a Kubernetes Secret.
external_actions: read non-sensitive AWS, EKS, ECR, Kubernetes API discovery, and artifact metadata in account 106760547719
retrieve reviewed public cert-manager release metadata and mirror only the approved chart and digest-pinned controller images into the existing approved private ECR supply chain
install or update only the approved private cert-manager release in its dedicated namespace through the private EKS path
apply only Vault-scoped cert-manager Issuer and Certificate manifests so cert-manager creates or updates its own CA-key Secret and vault/vault-tls
read non-sensitive Kubernetes resource status, Certificate conditions, and Secret key names only
prohibited_actions: read Secret data or private keys

primary_owner.responsibility: PKI boundary, authorization gate, final integration, and Vault deployment unblock decision

delegations.escalation_trigger: public egress, Secret data, or cluster-wide CA reuse is required
requires a direct Secret operation or unapproved cloud resource
bundle contains secret material or claims unsupported by evidence

validation: offline Helm render and manifest policy checks
Certificate ready condition and Secret key-name-only check
